task: Implement the owner-session canonical runtime contract so local story owner leases stay stable across multi-host repeated invocations without adding provider-specific branches to generic core code.
outcome: After completion, the user can run owner-session smoke/guardrail verification and see terminal output equivalent to: `✓ story-owner-lease smoke passed` plus `PASS owner-session host-native env guardrail`; `session_brief` and non-owner diagnostics report explicit-env/generated-token/derived-ppid source labels, and repeated commands with the same LATTICE_SESSION_ID do not self-reject as foreign owners when parent PID changes.
facts: B-a781 produced docs/requirements/decisions/owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md as the execution plan for this runtime work.
Current runtime behavior resolves session identity with LATTICE_SESSION_ID then CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID then ppid-derived fallback inside core/story-owner-lease.ts.
handlers/context.ts and handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts currently contain ad hoc session env reads for lifecycle events or DEV-claim warning logic.
core/lattice-dispatch.ts is the current dispatch runtime/probe/env boundary for Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity/agy, and legacy Gemini compatibility.
The owner-session id is local non-cryptographic coordination metadata and must not be treated as Authority or reviewer proof.
Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, Antigravity CLI via agy, and Lattice CLI are installed on this machine.
Main currently has unrelated B-b29e untracked scope-check metadata that must not be touched by this story.
constraints: Do not run omx or read/write/use .omx directories.
Do not directly edit docs/story or tests/fixtures; use Lattice commands for story and fixture metadata.
Runtime code changes must stay inside the B-9089 execution boundary and scope boundary.
Generic owner-lease/lifecycle/gate/cli-engine paths must not gain host-native session env exceptions.
Generated-token storage, if persisted, must be registered as a runtime artifact and not dirty material diffs.
Local owner-session evidence must not claim Authority Server completion or cryptographic identity.
Do not broaden this story into Gemini-to-Antigravity provider migration; active B-fbb6 owns that semantic migration.
